title: Servis Mühendisi
desc:
1.Technical Troubleshooting & Diagnostics
Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair a broad range of LiuGong construction equipment.
Perform root-cause analysis and recommend corrective actions.
Provide both remote and on-site technical support to dealers and end users.
Use LiuGong OEM diagnostic tools and software for mechanical, hydraulic, electrical, and electronic systems.
Prepare technical findings and assist with software updates when required.
2.Field Service & Customer Support
Conduct scheduled field visits, inspections, and urgent service calls across Türkiye.
Advise customers on equipment operation, maintenance standards, and technical best practices.
Deliver high-quality service reports and ensure timely communication with the Product Team and HQ technical experts.
Support the Product Team in equipment demonstrations, operator trainings, and field tests.
3. Warranty & Parts Coordination
Validate and follow up warranty cases with the regional and HQ technical teams.
Coordinate genuine parts recommendations and support dealers in parts ordering logistics.
Report quality issues through LiuGong internal systems to support continuous product improvement.
4. Training & Knowledge Transfer
Provide hands-on training to dealers, service engineers, and customers on safe operation and basic troubleshooting.
Stay updated on new product technologies, manuals, and service bulletins.
Assist in new product launches and support the Product Team during demos and pilot operations.
5. Compliance & Safety
Follow LiuGong OEM standards, field safety requirements, and local regulations.
Ensure documentation integrity and compliance with internal service procedures.
Requirements
3–4 years of experience in maintenance, diagnostics, and repair of CE.
Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic systems.
Good command of English.
Valid B class driving license.
High willingness to travel.
Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
Why LiuGong?
• Work for a global brand with 65+ years of engineering excellence.
• Strong growth opportunities as LiuGong expands in Turkey.
• Collaborate with international teams in Europe and China.
• Play a key role in shaping aftersales and product standards.
